source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: The Senate President, the Presiding Officer, and the Senator-Judges of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant at Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Senate Sergeant-at-Arms
turns.text: All persons are commanded to

turns.speaker: Senate Sergeant-at-Arms
turns.text: keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Raffy Tulfo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Almighty Father, as we begin another long day of trial, please send your most Holy Spirit upon each one of us to guide us in our proceedings. Use our eyes and ears to discover the truth, guide our minds to understand what is being discussed, and warm our hearts to have patience for each other and have compassion for the people for whom we perform our duties today. We especially pray for our witnesses who sacrificed their time and energy to help us achieve our roles here today. Finally, give us enough light moments throughout the day to remember that we are all humans and equal before your eyes. All these we pray in your mighty name. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: So kung meron kang ilalagay na 10.6 million pesos, meron kang expectation na lalaki yung pera?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: The expectation, your honor, is there. But the payouts are not guaranteed, your honor, because it is in the nature of an investment, your honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Sir, kapag gusto nang kunin ng cash value, gaano kabilis ito makukuha?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: If you're referring, your honor, to any withdrawal, upon the instruction of the client, they can withdraw the Value of the policy, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Gano po kabilis makukuha, Sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: If they instruct 3 or 5 business days, Your Honor, they will already be receiving the return of the money, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: At ano po ang mga kondisyon or kaltas kung kukuni na ang cash value?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Meron po mga surrender charges. Depende po on the year or the time that the client instructs withdrawal of the policy, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With your indulgence, Attorney [unclear], you're referring to the cash surrender value, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: I'm referring, Your Honor, to the withdrawal value, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Which is different from the cash surrender value of an insurance policy, if you cut it short?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: A cash

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: surrender value apologies are for the traditional life insurance product. For this type of policy, which is a unit-linked product. We usually call it po a withdrawal value.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Which is equivalent to the amount of the premium paid or smaller?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Which depending on the market, Your Honor, where the fund is invested may go higher or lower than the premiums paid, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: thank you. Your Witness, Honorable Suan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Sir, base po sa experience niyo o kaya naman sa anti-money laundering training niyo, kung meron man, Paano po pwedeng abusoy ng isang insurance policy para matakpan kung saan talaga galing ang pera o kung sino talaga ang mayari nito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Objection, Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Honor. Speculative and he calls for a conclusion and he would be incompetent, of course, Attorney. If he knows, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I would have to sustain the objection, Honorable Suan. Move on to your next point.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Kung iligal ang pinanggalingan ng pera, ipinasok sa insurance at kalaunan ay inilabas bilang payout. Pwede po bang magmukhang lehiti mo dahil insurance company ang nagbayad?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Same objection, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: It's a different question, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Same objection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Apologies, counsels. Yes, can you repeat your question? Can you repeat your question, Honorable Suan?

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Kung iligal ang pinanggalingan ng pera, ipinasok sa insurance, at kalaunan ay inilabas bilang payout, pwede po bang magmukhang lehiti mo dahil insurance company ang nagbayad?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It would be speculative in no basis. You don't have to listen to the objection of the Honorable Attorney CJ.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But did you say that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Please move on, Honorable Suwan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Finally, Sir, itong 10.6 million pesos po na insurance investment ng asawa ng respondent, ano po ang status nito ngayon? Ano po siya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Active po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Okay. No further questions, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Any cross, attorney CJ?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Just a few,

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: your

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Good afternoon po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Good afternoon, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: You'd have to forgive me because I'm not as well-versed in insurance law as you are, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: May I show you section 3 of Republic Act number 10607, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: I will be flashing it on the screen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: May I request that this be flashed on the screen, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The tech is instructed to kindly flash

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: the requested slide of attorney Cesar.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Sir, you'd have to help me out a little. Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Sir, I'll just read the second paragraph there, alright? It says, Section 3. The consent of the spouse is not necessary for the validity of an insurance policy taken out by a married person on his or her life. or that of his children. Sir, my question is this. A married applicant can take out insurance on his own life without obtaining his spouse's consent or participation. Correct, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: The second paragraph, sir. Of section 3.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: The section 3, it would be consent of the spouse is not necessary, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What law is this, Attorney CJ?

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Sir, your honor, Republic Act number 10607 or the amendments to the insurance code.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Sir, let's go to section 11 of the same law.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Tech, please scroll. Section 11.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: I shall read for your ease, sir. The insured shall have the right to change the beneficiary he designated in the policy unless he has expressly waived the right in said policy. This sir pertains to a revocable beneficiary, correct sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: That's my understanding, your honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: And sir, a policyholder may name a beneficiary without informing that person, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: That's my understanding, your honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: And sir, based on that, it is the right of a policyholder also to change a revocable beneficiary without informing him or her, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: That is my understanding, your honor. based on section 11.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: you, sir. No further questions, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Carlo Joaquin T. Narvasa
turns.text: No further questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Senate President is... Senator Judge Erwin Tulfo is recognized. You may proceed, sir, with your interjection. I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Senator Judge Erwin. Any redirect on the part of the Honorable Suan?

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: No redirect,

turns.speaker: Rep. Lordan G. Suan
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. In that case, Senator Judge Erwin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Apologies for the confusion. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, presiding officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Witness, mahalaga ba sa insurance company ang source of funds ng isang malaking premium? Or it doesn't matter? Kasi kailangan natin magbenta ng insurance, di ba ba? Talagang binabalik-balikan pa nga natin yung tao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Do you factor that kung ika nga yung source of funds ng kliyente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, because the applicant must pay for the premium, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Do you also factor if it's a public official or asawa ng public official na kumukuha ng insurance investment? Or it doesn't matter?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Together with the other factors related to identification, Your Honor, of the applicant, it is part of our process, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So it is important na may perang pambayad ang policyholder?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: That the application form is usually accompanied, Your Honor, with the payment of the premium. Pero it doesn't

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: matter? You do not care kung saan manggagaling yung perang pambayad niya? Is this correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: We

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: conduct Our due diligence on the applicant and the funds, Your Honor, that accompanies the premium policy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So that's you do para malaman kung legitimate ang source ng funding?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: We identify the source, Your Honor, based on the records available to us.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Do you ask the policyholder or yung kliyente? Do you ask them ano ang source of income mo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: In the application form that will be filled out by the client, they will say their occupation and their source of funds, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So is it safe to say na relevant ang pagsusuri ng financial capacity nung kukuha ng insurance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: That factor, Your Honor, is part of our due diligence, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi tugma ang transaction sa non-financial profile ng customer. Iri-red flag ho ba yun? Or hindi ninyo itutuloy yung pagbibenta ng

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: insurance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: In a hypothetical case of when that happens, Your Honor, we will conduct further due diligence on the application before we accept the insurance.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Nangyari na po ba sa company nyo na gano'n na duda kayo sa kaduda-duda na baka kung saan galing yung pambayad na tinanggihanan ninyo o wala pa? Parang wala pa ako naririnig na gano'n.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Your Honor, we're mindful of the anti-money laundering law on tipping off and to comply with all of the regulations related to identification.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: All right.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alam niyo naman po na prominenteng tao ang involved nung kumuha po ng insurance and how he is related to, well, hindi pa siya vice president yata dati or she's already vice president. Alam niyo naman po yun. Tama po ba yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: We are aware, Your Honor, of the status of Mr. Maneses R. Carpio in the public, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright. Sir, bakit sako po ng anti-money laundering control sa insurance industry? Why is that, in your own opinion?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: In my opinion, Your Honor, any financial institution who receives money from the public is a, what we call it, proper person. to be covered by anti-money laundering law, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Is the right answer dahil maaring gamitin ng insurance products upang magpasok at mag-store ng substantial funds? Could that be one of the reasons?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Under the anti-money laundering law, there are predicate offenses, Your Honor. So my answer there would be... That is maybe one of the reasons, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Sa money laundering po, ano ang significance ng pagpasok ng pera sa isang insurance product at paglabas nito later as proceeds? Would you happen to know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: In money laundering law, Your Honor, there's placement or the cash that is put in the financial

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Industry, which includes insurance, layering wherein it passes through one financial institution to another, and of course, ultimately, integration where the proceeds or the withdrawal value will be turning into cash, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: May limitations po ba bilang ng insurance policies na maaaring kunin ng isang

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: tao? Depende, Your Honor, on the

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Occupation, source of funds. I would understand the answer there is there are limitations, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Last question, Mr. Presiding Officer. Can you detect na pag kumuha po ng policy, money laundering na pala nilalabhan nila nila o ng mga tao yung pera through insurance companies that it is already part of the money laundering scheme? Namumonitor nyo ba na yun? Natatrack ninyo? If so, what do you do?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Your Honor, under the anti-money laundering law, we are obligated to have indicators to determine if there are what you would call suspicious or unusual aspects of an applicant when they try to purchase insurance from us, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: But what do you do? For example, talagang suspected na... Nilo-launder yung pera, nililinis sa pamagitan ng pagkuhan po ng policies for investment. What will you do?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: At point of our application, Your Honor, we may not be able to determine if it is money laundering as will be defined by a court of proper jurisdiction. We, however, have a mandate from the Anti-Money Laundering Council and the Insurance Commission to identify the

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: kahit na alam po ninyo, pero kung wala pong court order, you will not do anything.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: If your honor, the court will order.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: As long as wala pong order ang court na may money laundering doon nakikita na ninyo dyan, wala po kayong gagawin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: As we view, when we say that there is money laundering, that would mean that a court of competent jurisdiction has already proved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: But how would the court know, sir, kung hindi po kayo magre-report, hindi po ninyo titignan? Hindi po ba, I think, mauna muna makikita ninyo bago yung court because kahawak po ninyo, you will look in there.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of Senator Judge Tulfo, insurance companies are covered institutions under the anti-money laundering law. If they find any transaction in excess of the threshold or found to be suspicious, they are mandated by the law. To report those transactions, but that's as far as it goes. Unless, as Attorney Terry said, a court of competent jurisdiction shall have already found the money for money laundering to have existed in that particular transaction. But they will report it, correct, Attorney Terry?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: They will just report it to the Presiding Officer, but they will not terminate the contract, right?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Because there is no determination yet by a court of competent jurisdiction in that regard. If they do that, they will be sued by the policyholder, I suppose.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Hindi katulad ng mga bank deposits na very clear. Bank deposits, cash yan. Itong mga insurance policies, nag-evolve na kasi sila. At marami sa ating mga kababayan, hindi masyadong kabisado kung ano itong insurance policies na nag-evolve na into, sabi nyo kanina, variable unit link insurance. Gusto kong ma-educate para ma-educate rin yung mga kababayan natin. Kanina ay pinakita po na yung premium ay 10.6 million pesos. At nasabi rin kanina na ibabalik ito at one point at 13.200 million pesos. So ang ibig sabihin ba nito ho, guarantee na yung 13.2 million pesos na ibabalik?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Your Honor, the sum assured reflects the amount payable. When the covered event occurs in a life insurance policy, the covered event po is the death of the named insured.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So, ibig sabihin kung may yung beneficiary pag namatay, makukuha niya 13.2 million pesos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: 13,250,000 pesos, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yes, oo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung 10 million naman, 0.6, ito ba ay pwedeng bumaba? O pwede pang lumaki?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pwede siyang bumaba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dito sa policy ninyo nakita ko ang benefit period is age 100. Anong ibig sabihin nun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: The person is covered up to the age of 100, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. At dito rin nakita ko na Yung single premium payable is 10.6 million pesos. So ibig sabihin, ito yung halaga na ibinayad ng policyholder.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ito ba ay pwede nating matawag asset?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Itong 10.6 million pesos, is this considered asset of a person, yung policyholder?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: A financial product, Your Honor, is a specie of personal property. and therefore it can be an asset depending of course on other factors.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yes, but for this particular policy, itong 10.6 million pesos, considered ba ito asset ng tao?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: I can say sir that the 10.6 million paid for this depending on whether it's withdrawn or it becomes Death Claim, there will be money coming out of this account, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Correct. So is that considered an asset?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Specifically solely for this transaction, it is my reading of the law, Your Honor. It's personal property and is therefore an asset.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: An

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: asset.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung 13.2

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: million pesos, is that considered an asset?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: This is a... What you would call a covered insurance payable. And then of course, unless the covered event occurs, this is not yet, in my view, an asset. This is a future event.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: A life insurance contract is based on a future event, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero guaranteed na yung maibibigay ng 13.2. So do you consider that As an asset in your calculation of your assets.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Kung

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: magkukumpute ka ng asset, ang asset ko ay ganito, in 30.2 ba pwede kong makonsidered as my asset? Kasi guaranteed na yun eh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Again, your honor, a life insurance product is dependent on the occurrence of the covert event.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So hindi pa, kasi hindi pa nangyayari yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: My understanding, your honor, is it's not claimable. until the covered event occurs, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And then, narinig ko kanina tinanong ng ating presiding officer na at any given time, pwedeng tanggalin itong premium na 10.6?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: There is

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: a withdrawable value, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: winit draw ba ito, may kita?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Depending on the market performance of which the variable fund is linked, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: pwedeng kumita, pwedeng hindi kumita?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Hapa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Alright. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Sotto is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President of

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: the Co-Officials. Medyo nagtatalo na ako dito kanina. Gusto lang namin nalinawan eh, dahil baka ang intindi ng iba. Pag sinabing insurance, may

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: ini

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: -insure. Patulad ng regular na insurance. Ito po, investment ito, you know. Attorney Roman?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: So, in this case, dito sa 10.6 na... Pinasok na investment sa insurance. Sinong beneficiary?

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: The beneficiary, Your Honor, are the children.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Tapos ang in

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: -insure,

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: yung pera at yung siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Juan Sotero Roman
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Si Atty. Calpio. O

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: by the way, are you related

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: to Pablo Roman?
